x-lys-wm-actions.name: focus
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move focus to the neighbouring window, or to the next output at the edge.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: move
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window, hy3 style; at the workspace edge it crosses to the neighbouring output's workspace, entering its tree at the near edge, and focus follows. A floating window steps by `floating.step` pixels inside the usable area, and from its edge crosses to the neighbouring output.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: workspace
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Show workspace n, or the one a workspace rule names, on its bound output when a rule binds it; the n-th open workspace after or before the current one, of every output (e) or of the focused output (m); the lowest free number, opened on the focused output (empty); or the one the output showed before it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movetoworkspace
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window to a workspace, chosen as for workspace; with follow, show that workspace with the window focused, in one switch.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focusoutput
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Focus the neighbouring output in that direction, or the output with that name, and the window focused there.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movetooutput
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window onto the workspace that output shows and focus it there; a floating window keeps its place relative to the output.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: moveworkspacetooutput
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused workspace with its windows, layout and focus to that output and show it there; floating windows keep their place relative to the output, inside its area.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: swapworkspaces
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Swap the workspaces two outputs show, each with its windows; an output is a direction from the focused one or a name.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: scratchpad
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Show the named scratchpad over the focused output, above its workspace and dimming it, or hide it when it shows there; one shown elsewhere moves here. A scratchpad holds windows like a workspace that no number reaches. Toggling one that is empty runs its `exec` from `scratchpads`, and the window that opens lands in it. hide hides the one over the focused output.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movetoscratchpad
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window into the named scratchpad; it hides with the scratchpad unless that shows on its output. movetoworkspace brings it back.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: kill
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Ask the focused window to close.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focuswindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Focus the window with this IPC ID, showing its workspace on its output and raising it, and its tab when grouped; a minimized window comes back.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: minimize
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Hide the focused window, or the one with this IPC ID, with its dialogs; the rest of its workspace takes its space.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: restore
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Bring back the window with this IPC ID, or the one minimized last on the focused workspace, and focus it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: overview
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Open or close the overview on every output: each output's windows side by side under a strip of its workspaces. Without an argument, toggle.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: closewindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Ask the window with this IPC ID to close.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: dpms
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Turn outputs on or off, or one output by name; off outputs keep their windows and wake only on dpms on.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: reload
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Read the config file again; a bad file keeps the running config and reports the error.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: dismissconfignotice
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Hide the notice on screen about config problems; `lys-wmctl configproblems` still lists them, and the next reload shows what it finds.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: exit
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: End the session: lys-wm closes its clients, Xwayland and IPC socket and exits, as on SIGTERM.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: nextlayout
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Switch the keyboard to its next layout, wrapping after the last. With one layout it does nothing.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: stickykeys
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Turn sticky keys on or off: a modifier pressed and released alone applies to the next key, pressed twice it stays on until pressed again.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: slowkeys
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Accept a key only once it was held this many milliseconds; 0 turns slow keys off.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: global
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Press the global shortcut an application registered, and release it with the bind.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: exec
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Run a shell command with sh -c.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: makegroup
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Wrap the focused window in a new group; an ephemeral group dissolves when one window is left.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: changegroup
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Change the layout of the focused group, or of the group around the focused window, keeping its ratios. toggletab switches between tabs and the split it had before, h for a group made as tabs; opposite turns h into v and back.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focustab
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Show the previous, next or n-th tab of the nearest tab group around the focused window; prev and next stop at the ends unless wrap.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focusparent
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Focus the group around the focused window or group, drawn with the active border, so move, swap, moveout, kill, togglefloating and movetoworkspace act on all of it; keyboard input still goes to the window inside.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focuschild
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Undo one focusparent, down toward the focused window.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: swap
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Exchange the focused window or group with its neighbour in that direction; each slot keeps its size.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: moveout
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Lift the focused window or group out of its group, placing it after that group in the one around it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: equalize
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Give the children of the focused group, or of the group around the focused window, equal shares again; all does so for the whole tree.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: locktab
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Lock the nearest tab group around the focused window: new windows open beside it instead of in it, and move and swap neither enter nor leave it, though its tabs still reorder. toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: submap
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Switch binds to the named submap, or back to the default ones.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: togglefloating
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Float the focused window centred at half the output, or tile it again.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: place
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Float the focused window onto that half, quarter or the whole usable area, inside the gaps and its size limits, the same rect a drag to that edge snaps to, or centre it; restore returns it to where it was, floating or tiled, before the last place or drag snap.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focusfloating
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move focus between the floating windows of the focused workspace (on) and its tiled ones (off); toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: fullscreen
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Make the focused window cover its output, above the top layer, or end that; toggle unless told. With fake the window stays where it is and is only told it is fullscreen, so a video player in a tile fills the tile.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: setprop
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Give the window with this IPC ID a rule key until it closes, as a rule matching only it would, after every rule: `setprop 7 border {active: red}`, `setprop 7 opacity 0.8`. The value is YAML, as in the config file.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: showdesktop
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Slide the windows of the output under the pointer, or of every output with all, toward their nearest edges until only a sliver of each shows, to reach the desktop. Nothing is resized and the layout stays; keyboard focus leaves the windows. A click on a sliver, a window opening or being activated there, a workspace switch or focusing a window ends it, as does the action again. toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: swallow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: For a window that swallowed the terminal it was started from (see `swallow` in config.md), or that terminal: off shows the terminal again beside the window, on hides it in the window's place once more; toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: pin
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Keep the focused window on screen through workspace switches of its output, floating above the workspace's other floating windows; a tiled window floats first. toggle unless told; moving it to a workspace or tiling it unpins it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: maximize
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Make the focused window fill its output's usable area inside the outer gaps, keeping bars and its border, above its workspace's other windows, or end that; toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: resizeactive
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Grow or shrink the focused window by pixels; tiled windows move their right or bottom edge, else their left or top one.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movewindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Mouse binds only: drag the window under the pointer; tiled windows drop into the tree where released. A window drawing its own title bar starts the same drag with xdg_toplevel.move or _NET_WM_MOVERESIZE, with the button or touch point it was pressed with.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: resizewindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Mouse binds only: resize the window under the pointer from its nearest corner; tiled windows change their split ratios. A window drawing its own edges starts the same drag from the edge it names with xdg_toplevel.resize or _NET_WM_MOVERESIZE.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: zoom
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Magnify the output under the pointer around the pointer: by factor, 1.5 unless given, from where it is going, back to 1, or to factor, up to 16.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: debug
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Debugging a running session, bound to nothing by default. `damage` fills each frame's damage with a tint that fades over 8 frames; `opaque` tints what the culler takes as opaque; `planes` tints every composited frame, so whatever shows untinted went to direct scanout or an overlay plane. `trace` records the frame trace of `-frame-trace` to an absolute path, `profile` a Go CPU profile, and `heap` writes a heap profile once.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: stickykeys
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Turn sticky keys on or off: a modifier pressed and released alone applies to the next key, pressed twice it stays on until pressed again.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: slowkeys
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Accept a key only once it was held this many milliseconds; 0 turns slow keys off.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: global
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Press the global shortcut an application registered, and release it with the bind.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: exec
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Run a shell command with sh -c.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: makegroup
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Wrap the focused window in a new group; an ephemeral group dissolves when one window is left.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: changegroup
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Change the layout of the focused group, or of the group around the focused window, keeping its ratios. toggletab switches between tabs and the split it had before, h for a group made as tabs; opposite turns h into v and back.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focustab
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Show the previous, next or n-th tab of the nearest tab group around the focused window; prev and next stop at the ends unless wrap.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focusparent
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Focus the group around the focused window or group, drawn with the active border, so move, swap, moveout, kill, togglefloating and movetoworkspace act on all of it; keyboard input still goes to the window inside.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focuschild
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Undo one focusparent, down toward the focused window.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: swap
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Exchange the focused window or group with its neighbour in that direction; each slot keeps its size.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: moveout
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Lift the focused window or group out of its group, placing it after that group in the one around it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: equalize
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Give the children of the focused group, or of the group around the focused window, equal shares again; all does so for the whole tree.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: locktab
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Lock the nearest tab group around the focused window: new windows open beside it instead of in it, and move and swap neither enter nor leave it, though its tabs still reorder. toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: submap
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Switch binds to the named submap, or back to the default ones.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: togglefloating
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Float the focused window centred at half the output, or tile it again.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: place
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Float the focused window onto that half, quarter or the whole usable area, inside the gaps and its size limits, the same rect a drag to that edge snaps to, or centre it; restore returns it to where it was, floating or tiled, before the last place or drag snap.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focusfloating
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move focus between the floating windows of the focused workspace (on) and its tiled ones (off); toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: fullscreen
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Make the focused window cover its output, above the top layer, or end that; toggle unless told. With fake the window stays where it is and is only told it is fullscreen, so a video player in a tile fills the tile.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: setprop
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Give the window with this IPC ID a rule key until it closes, as a rule matching only it would, after every rule: `setprop 7 border {active: red}`, `setprop 7 opacity 0.8`. The value is YAML, as in the config file.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: showdesktop
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Slide the windows of the output under the pointer, or of every output with all, toward their nearest edges until only a sliver of each shows, to reach the desktop. Nothing is resized and the layout stays; keyboard focus leaves the windows. A click on a sliver, a window opening or being activated there, a workspace switch or focusing a window ends it, as does the action again. toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: swallow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: For a window that swallowed the terminal it was started from (see `swallow` in config.md), or that terminal: off shows the terminal again beside the window, on hides it in the window's place once more; toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: pin
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Keep the focused window on screen through workspace switches of its output, floating above the workspace's other floating windows; a tiled window floats first. toggle unless told; moving it to a workspace or tiling it unpins it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: maximize
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Make the focused window fill its output's usable area inside the outer gaps, keeping bars and its border, above its workspace's other windows, or end that; toggle unless told.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: resizeactive
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Grow or shrink the focused window by pixels; tiled windows move their right or bottom edge, else their left or top one.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movewindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Mouse binds only: drag the window under the pointer; tiled windows drop into the tree where released. A window drawing its own title bar starts the same drag with xdg_toplevel.move or _NET_WM_MOVERESIZE, with the button or touch point it was pressed with.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: resizewindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Mouse binds only: resize the window under the pointer from its nearest corner; tiled windows change their split ratios. A window drawing its own edges starts the same drag from the edge it names with xdg_toplevel.resize or _NET_WM_MOVERESIZE.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: zoom
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Magnify the output under the pointer around the pointer: by factor, 1.5 unless given, from where it is going, back to 1, or to factor, up to 16.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: debug
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Debugging a running session, bound to nothing by default. `damage` fills each frame's damage with a tint that fades over 8 frames; `opaque` tints what the culler takes as opaque; `planes` tints every composited frame, so whatever shows untinted went to direct scanout or an overlay plane. `trace` records the frame trace of `-frame-trace` to an absolute path, `profile` a Go CPU profile, and `heap` writes a heap profile once.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focus
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move focus to the neighbouring window, or to the next output at the edge.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: move
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window, hy3 style; at the workspace edge it crosses to the neighbouring output's workspace, entering its tree at the near edge, and focus follows. A floating window steps by `floating.step` pixels inside the usable area, and from its edge crosses to the neighbouring output.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: workspace
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Show workspace n, or the one a workspace rule names, on its bound output when a rule binds it; the n-th open workspace after or before the current one, of every output (e) or of the focused output (m); the lowest free number, opened on the focused output (empty); or the one the output showed before it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movetoworkspace
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window to a workspace, chosen as for workspace; with follow, show that workspace with the window focused, in one switch.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focusoutput
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Focus the neighbouring output in that direction, or the output with that name, and the window focused there.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movetooutput
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window onto the workspace that output shows and focus it there; a floating window keeps its place relative to the output.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: moveworkspacetooutput
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused workspace with its windows, layout and focus to that output and show it there; floating windows keep their place relative to the output, inside its area.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: swapworkspaces
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Swap the workspaces two outputs show, each with its windows; an output is a direction from the focused one or a name.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: scratchpad
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Show the named scratchpad over the focused output, above its workspace and dimming it, or hide it when it shows there; one shown elsewhere moves here. A scratchpad holds windows like a workspace that no number reaches. Toggling one that is empty runs its `exec` from `scratchpads`, and the window that opens lands in it. hide hides the one over the focused output.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: movetoscratchpad
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Move the focused window into the named scratchpad; it hides with the scratchpad unless that shows on its output. movetoworkspace brings it back.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: kill
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Ask the focused window to close.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: focuswindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Focus the window with this IPC ID, showing its workspace on its output and raising it, and its tab when grouped; a minimized window comes back.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: minimize
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Hide the focused window, or the one with this IPC ID, with its dialogs; the rest of its workspace takes its space.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: restore
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Bring back the window with this IPC ID, or the one minimized last on the focused workspace, and focus it.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: overview
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Open or close the overview on every output: each output's windows side by side under a strip of its workspaces. Without an argument, toggle.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: closewindow
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Ask the window with this IPC ID to close.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: dpms
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Turn outputs on or off, or one output by name; off outputs keep their windows and wake only on dpms on.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: reload
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Read the config file again; a bad file keeps the running config and reports the error.

x-lys-wm-actions.name: dismissconfignotice
x-lys-wm-actions.summary: Hide the notice on screen about config problems; `lys-wmctl configproblems` still lists them, and the next reload shows what it finds.
